scope: Confirm attack-permission restore and prevent unresolved baseline recapture after operation retirement
implementation: OperationRestore consumes groupAttack proof after confirmed restore or explicit supersession, not before the native write. Native readback must match original value before RESTORED.

One unconfirmed native write retains original restore entry and one separate public unresolved receipt [generation,epoch,original,applied,owner,serverTime]. Cancel/Release may retire operation movement without erasing this evidence.
Repeated restore with unresolved evidence does not repeat enableAttack. No automatic retry or worker: native write is synchronous and an immediate mission override may be intentional.

OperationAttackPolicy refuses acquisition while unresolved original restriction remains. Current local observation of original native value may retire typed metadata, even after ownership changes; no old command authority or original baseline is imported into a new receipt.

validation.focused: .qa/attack-restore-confirm-tests.log:15 existing operation checks passed before final repeated-write/metadata-only retirement refinement.
validation.full: .qa/attack-restore-confirm-build.log:1489 tests/401 SQF and complete offline gates passed.

limits: No eventual-restoration claim when a mission/controller rejects the permission. That controller must relinquish/change the native permission before fresh acquisition proceeds. Unresolved metadata is bounded one per group, not active retry work.
Identical new permission writes cannot be distinguished by property snapshots.
Physical override/release/ownership transitions and performance unverified; audits PAUSED.
